raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Malformed requests either ran the model or got a 5xx with internal error text back. This was found on sglang-torchtpu (sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu#1266) and fixed there in sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu#1651. The code is shared and hardware-agnostic, and sglang `main` has the same gaps, so this ports the fix to keep the fork and upstream in sync.

## Modifications

| Case | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `/generate` with out-of-vocab or non-integer `input_ids` returned 200 and ran the model | `TokenizerManager._validate_one_request` range-checks `token_ids_logprob` but never the prompt `input_ids` | New `_validate_input_ids_in_vocab`: every client-supplied id must be an int (not bool) in `[0, vocab_size)`, otherwise 400 |
| `max_new_tokens: "ten"` returned a bare 500 | `max_new_tokens + input_token_num` runs before `SamplingParams.verify`, so a string raises `TypeError` | Type check before that arithmetic: a non-int gets a 400 |
| chat/completions `n: 0` returned a 400 that leaked `range() arg 3 must not be zero` | `n` had no bound on `ChatCompletionRequest` or `CompletionRequest` | `n: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)` |
| Unreachable `image_url` on the media-artifact path (Qwen-VL, Kimi-K3) returned 500 with urllib3 internals | A `requests.RequestException` from `snapshot_media_source` escaped to the generic 500 handler | Catch it there and raise a 400 `Failed to fetch media URL <url>: <timed out / connection failed / HTTP n / ...>` |

The id check skips:
- `input_embeds` requests
- `positional_embed_overrides` requests
- empty ids
- ids produced by the tokenizer or the multimodal processor

Unknown `model` names are still accepted on chat/completions, as before.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. Only request validation changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Validation

- New `test/registered/unit/managers/test_generate_request_validation.py`, plus cases in `test_protocol.py` (`n >= 1`) and `test_media_artifact_processor.py` (connection refused, HTTP 404, timeout; real sockets).
- Upstream `main` with the new tests: 18 failed. With this PR: 26 passed, 28 subtests passed. Both runs on CPU, py3.13, torch 2.11.0+cpu.
- The same change in sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu#1651 was verified end to end on a TPU v7x Qwen3-VL-8B server:

| Request | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| out-of-vocab `input_ids` | 200 | 400 |
| `max_new_tokens: "ten"` | 500 | 400 |
| `n: 0` | leaked `range()` error | 400 on `body.n` |
| unreachable `image_url` | 500 with urllib3 internals | 400 naming the URL |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Unit tests for /generate request validation in TokenizerManager (issue #1266)."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import GenerateReqInput
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import TokenizerManager
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_VOCAB_SIZE = 100
+
+
+class TestGenerateRequestValidation(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        override = get_context().override_server_args()
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+        self.manager = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+        self.manager.context_len = 128
+        self.manager.num_reserved_tokens = 0
+        self.manager.allow_auto_truncate = False
+        self.manager.validate_total_tokens = True
+        self.manager.is_generation = True
+        self.manager.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            joint_head_config=None, pointer_head=None, vocab_size=_VOCAB_SIZE
+        )
+
+    def _validate(self, req, input_ids=None):
+        # Mirror the HTTP path: the request is normalized before validation.
+        req.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+        if input_ids is None:
+            input_ids = req.input_ids
+        self.manager._validate_one_request(req, input_ids)
+
+    def test_accepts_input_ids_at_vocab_boundaries(self):
+        self._validate(GenerateReqInput(input_ids=[0, _VOCAB_SIZE - 1]))
+
+    def test_rejects_out_of_vocab_input_ids(self):
+        for input_ids, bad_id in (
+            ([1000000000, -5], -5),
+            ([1, _VOCAB_SIZE], _VOCAB_SIZE),
+            ([-1, 2], -1),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(input_ids=input_ids):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                    ValueError,
+                    rf"input_ids contains out-of-vocabulary token id {bad_id}; "
+                    rf"valid range is \[0, {_VOCAB_SIZE}\)",
+                ):
+                    self._validate(GenerateReqInput(input_ids=input_ids))
+
+    def test_rejects_non_integer_input_ids(self):
+        # A non-integer between integer extremes must not slip past a
+        # min/max-only check.
+        for input_ids in ([1, "2"], [1, 2.5, 3], [1, None], [1, True, 3]):
+            with self.subTest(input_ids=input_ids):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "input_ids must be integers"):
+                    self._validate(GenerateReqInput(input_ids=input_ids))
+
+    def test_text_prompt_ids_are_not_checked_against_vocab(self):
+        # Ids produced by the tokenizer or a multimodal processor are trusted;
+        # only client-supplied input_ids are range-checked.
+        self._validate(GenerateReqInput(text="hi"), input_ids=[_VOCAB_SIZE + 5])
+
+    def test_rejects_non_integer_max_new_tokens(self):
+        for value in ("ten", 1.5, [4]):
+            with self.subTest(max_new_tokens=value):
+                req = GenerateReqInput(
+                    text="hi", sampling_params={"max_new_tokens": value}
+                )
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                    ValueError, "max_new_tokens must be an integer"
+                ):
+                    self._validate(req, input_ids=[1, 2])
+
+    def test_accepts_integer_max_new_tokens(self):
+        req = GenerateReqInput(text="hi", sampling_params={"max_new_tokens": 8})
+        self._validate(req, input_ids=[1, 2])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+def _closed_port_url() -> str:

+class TestMediaArtifactFetchErrors(CustomTestCase):
+    """A media URL the server cannot fetch is a client error (issue #1266)."""
